text: Keep order in the town, adventurer.
Axel is safe. Almost always. Don't hit the townsfolk.
The monsters outside are getting bolder. Take care.
If you hear a goddess screaming, the problem is probably a toad.
Lately the undead have been showing up at night. A priest would help... or a goddess. If she's sober.
People talk about monsters ambushing travelers outside the walls. Stay alert.

guild.text: The Guild is the big building north of the square. The quest board is in the square and inside it.
